svg.data-power-max-with-additional-psu: 1150 W (brochure: "600 W (1150 W with additional PSU)")
svg.data-poe-current-limit: 560 mA (af/at) / 1667 mA (bt) per port at input above 30 V; 17.82 A total
svg.data-power-input: 100 - 240 V AC, 50-60 Hz, one input, two supply slots
svg.data-power-rating-label: 100-240 V ~9 A MAX, 50/60 Hz (printed on the rear)
svg.data-optics-sfp-plus: brochure: the four SFP+ ports support 1G, 2.5G and 10G speeds depending on the module; none is included
